_comment: DNB progressions. Chord progressions are freely copyable (settled law); these are the harmonic families from docs/idiom-research/genre-reggae-dub-bass.md section D2. Liquid is the progression-driven substyle (dorian two-chord, aeolian cadence, soul seesaw, ii-iii-IV ascent); jungle/techstep is a static minor drone. m9/add9 extensions come from the pack's rootless9 voicings (m9 is not a schema quality token). bII neighbor menace is not expressible in diatonic 1-7 degree space and is intentionally omitted.
